Are blocks removed from the bottom row only when all W columns have a block in row 1 at the same instant, or does 'filled' mean exactly W blocks regardless of duplicates?
When a block is removed from the bottom row, is it permanently gone, or could it reappear later?
If a block is in the bottom row but the bottom row is not completely filled, does it stay there indefinitely until the row fills?
Do we consider time 0 as the initial configuration before any moves, and queries about time T_j refer to after T_j time steps have been applied?
If a block moves downward into a cell that already contains a block (from above), is that allowed?
Is the bottom row removal checked once per time step, or could it happen multiple times within a single time step if blocks keep filling it?
